mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BANNER_TBL ( BANNER_NO, NOTICE_NO, BANNER_TITLE, IMG_PATH, BANNER_YN ) VALUES ( SEQ_BANNER_NO.NEXTVAL, #{noticeNo}, #{bannerTitle}, #{imgPath}, COALESCE(#{bannerYn}, 'Y') )
mapper.select: SELECT BANNER_NO AS bannerNo, NOTICE_NO AS noticeNo, BANNER_TITLE AS bannerTitle, IMG_PATH AS imgPath, BANNER_YN AS bannerYn FROM BANNER_TBL WHERE BANNER_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY BANNER_NO DESC
SELECT BANNER_NO AS bannerNo, NOTICE_NO AS noticeNo, BANNER_TITLE AS bannerTitle, IMG_PATH AS imgPath, BANNER_YN AS bannerYn FROM BANNER_TBL WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
